output.summary: Clause 7c requires Tenant to fund full capital replacement of the 10-ton rooftop HVAC unit (compressor/heat-exchanger failure), costing $26,500 per Property Inspection Memo. This single replacement exceeds the $3,000 annual cap by over 8x, violating the exposure limit. No other repair clauses shift additional capital risk to Tenant.
key_claims: Clause 7c mandates Tenant-paid capital replacement of 10-ton rooftop HVAC unit upon compressor/heat-exchanger failure
Property Inspection Memo states full replacement cost is $26,500 for 19-year-old unit
$26,500 replacement cost exceeds $3,000 annual cap by 787%
risks_or_flaws: Clause 7c shifts $26,500 capital replacement risk to Tenant, violating <=$3,000/yr exposure cap
